items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: He played most with Jimmy Noon.

ctx.x: He played most with Jimmy Noon. Hilaire. Yeah. Yeah, the man played a nice band there, but he didn't get off either.
He just played a nice horn, that's all. That's funny about Hilaire because you never hear about him down here, but he worked with all the New Orleans guys up there. Yeah. Played with them up there.
Yeah, I remember. Right there. They had a Westside, Greenland, too, you know, out there, Jimmy Nune and Shepard's and...
Oh yeah, I remember that. I remember that.
